name: Page notes (pipebox-style)
description: Local page-notes workspace: a markdown sidebar on any page, selection highlights collected as anchored quotes, a card+tag notes library on the admin page, and note_* tools agents can write to. Notes live in ~/.agentchat/notes/ — no cloud account.

extraTools.name: notes_list
extraTools.description: List saved notes (summaries, newest first). Filter by query (title/content/tag/url substring), tag, domain, or exact page url. Answered by the hub — no tab needed.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring over title, content, tags, url.

extraTools.name: note_get
extraTools.description: Read one note in full — markdown content, tags, and collected page quotes (each quote carries the anchor that re-highlights it on the page).

extraTools.name: note_save
extraTools.description: Create a note or update fields of an existing one. Pass id to update (title/url/domain/tags/content — only provided fields change); omit id to create. Content is markdown; {id, title, url, tags, content} are stored and the full note is returned.

url.description: Page the note belongs to — sets domain automatically.

extraTools.name: note_append
extraTools.description: Append a markdown chunk to an existing note (blank-line separated). Use for adding findings, exports, or summaries to a note without rewriting it.

extraTools.name: note_quote
extraTools.description: Attach a page quote to a note — the text plus optional source url and a serialized DOM anchor ({xpath,start,end}) so the page sidebar can re-highlight it. This is how 'collect this selection' records evidence.

extraTools.name: note_delete
extraTools.description: Delete a note by id. Its quotes and tags go with it; pasted-image assets stay under ~/.agentchat/notes/assets/.

extraTools.name: notes_stats
extraTools.description: Notes store stats: {notes, quotes, tags, assets, bytes}. Answered by the hub — no tab needed.

prompt:
You have a page-notes plugin (local markdown notes under ~/.agentchat/notes/). Use it when the user wants to remember, collect, or organize findings on the web — prefer these tools over writing files elsewhere.

- notes_list / note_get find and read notes; note_save creates or updates one (pass url of the page it belongs to so domain/tagging work); note_append adds a chunk without rewriting; note_delete removes.
- When the user asks to 'save this', '记下来', or collect evidence from a page: note_quote attaches the exact text + source url (and DOM anchor when the page provides one) to a note — then confirm where it was saved.
- The user can also take notes themselves in the in-page sidebar (right-edge handle or context menu) — their highlights and quotes land in the same store, so a note they started is readable via note_get.
- Notes library lives on the admin page (http://127.0.0.1:9010/admin) — point the user there to browse cards by tag.
